title: Popular Pets Around the World
summary: Dogs, cats, goldfish, and birds are common pets. Hermit crabs are a fun, unusual choice, and pet choices can differ from country to country.

cover.alt: Three adults in a sunlit living room with a dog, a cat on a lap, a goldfish bowl, and a budgie in a cage.

blocks.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Dogs, cats, goldfish, and birds are common pets. Hermit crabs are a fun, unusual choice, and pet choices can differ from country to country.

items.prompt: What pet do you think is popular near your home?
What do you think makes an animal a good pet?
If you could have any pet, what would you choose?

blocks.title: Part 1: What Is a Pet?
paragraphs: A pet is an animal that people keep for company or fun. Dogs and cats are very popular pets. Fish and birds are common pets too. People may want a pet for friendship, beauty, or help protecting a home. When we compare pets, we can ask three simple questions: Does it fit the home? How much time does it need? Why does the person want it?

images.alt: On one side an adult walks a golden dog on a leafy street; on the other the same adult sits indoors stroking a tabby cat by a sunny window.

blocks.title: Check: Part 1: What Is a Pet?

items.prompt: What three questions can help us compare pets?
items.answer: We can ask about the home, the time needed, and the person’s reason for wanting a pet.

blocks.title: Part 2: Dogs and Cats
paragraphs: Dogs often live closely with people. Many people enjoy playing with them and taking them for walks. Cats also give people company, but they can be quieter at home. Cats can live indoors and usually need less outdoor walking than many dogs. For example, a busy person in an apartment may prefer a cat, while an active family may enjoy walking with a dog.

items.prompt: Why might a busy person prefer a cat to a dog?
items.answer: A busy person might prefer a cat because cats usually need less outdoor walking than many dogs.

blocks.title: Part 3: Goldfish and Birds
paragraphs: A goldfish is a freshwater fish often kept in an indoor aquarium, a glass home for fish. Goldfish were first bred for color in China and later spread to other countries. Birds can also be colorful companions. Budgies and cockatiels are popular pet birds. People may choose birds for their company, color, or song. Both fish and birds can bring beauty into a home.

images.alt: On one side an adult watches an orange goldfish in a clear tank; on the other the same adult talks gently to a green and yellow budgie in a kitchen.

items.prompt: What can goldfish and pet birds bring into a home?
items.answer: Goldfish and pet birds can bring color and beauty into a home, and birds can also bring company or song.

blocks.title: Part 4: An Unusual Pet
paragraphs: Some people keep hermit crabs as pets. A hermit crab can be a fun or unusual choice because it is very different from a dog, cat, fish, or bird. Here, unusual does not mean bad. It means that fewer people first think of this animal when they hear the word “pet.” A person may choose one because they enjoy small and interesting animals.

items.prompt: Why can a hermit crab be called an unusual pet?
items.answer: A hermit crab can be called unusual because fewer people first think of it as a pet.

blocks.title: Part 5: Pets in Different Countries
paragraphs: People in different countries may choose different pets because their homes, daily routines, and reasons are different. Imagine one person in a small apartment and another person in a house with more outdoor space. The first person may choose a goldfish or cat. The second may choose a dog for walks and play. Some people want friendship, while others enjoy an animal’s beauty or want help protecting a home.

blocks.title: Check: Part 5: Pets in Different Countries

items.prompt: Why can pet choices differ between people in different countries?
items.answer: Pet choices can differ because people may have different homes, routines, and reasons for keeping an animal.
items.explanation: What do you think is the strongest reason for choosing a pet?

blocks.title: Part 6: Choosing the Right Pet
paragraphs: A popular pet is not always the right pet for every person. It is important to think again about home, time, and reason. A dog may suit someone who enjoys daily walks. A cat may suit a quieter indoor home. A goldfish needs an aquarium, and a bird may interest someone who likes color and song. Someone who wants a less common animal may think about a hermit crab.

images.alt: An adult holds a hermit crab over a sandy shell tank while another adult compares pet-care picture cards beside a small goldfish bowl.

blocks.title: Check: Part 6: Choosing the Right Pet

items.prompt: What should a person think about before choosing a pet?
items.answer: A person should think about their home, their available time, and their reason for wanting a pet.

items.prompt: Which pet would you choose for your home, and what would you do to make it a good choice?
